name: owndrop
description: Open-source personal cross-device drop & clipboard hub — Cloudflare Native ($0/mo) and Docker self-hostable.

scripts.build:web: (test -d web/node_modules || npm --prefix web ci) && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -y && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:web && npm run deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix web run typecheck
